page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of RAM, establishing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place the ecs.r7.6xlarge in the average tier for most compute and memory operations. It achieves a Geekbench multi-core score of 11384.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 29229.28. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only cached speed of 1263.88 GB/sec and an uncached large block write speed of 62.93 GB/sec. Notably, the instance demonstrates strong performance in small-model LLM text generation, reaching 283.7 tokens/sec with a 135M model, while maintaining average speeds of 14.18 tokens/sec on a medium 7B model.

The absence of local storage and GPU hardware represents a clear tradeoff, making this instance unsuitable for heavy graphics processing or local high-speed disk caching. However, the high memory density relative to the 24 dedicated cores provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require expensive GPU accelerators. The instance is well-suited for database operations, Redis caching, memory-intensive web serving, and software compilation.
